## Summary

A clear, concise description of the feature you'd like.

## Motivation

Why is this feature useful? What problem does it solve?

## Desired behavior

Describe how you expect the feature to work.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Scope

- Is this a UI change, a domain/storage change, a new provider, or a
  platform/device feature?
- Does it affect offline behavior, privacy, permissions, or network use?
- Roughly how large is the change? (Can help with prioritization.)

## Additional context

Anything else relevant.
